text:
Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗
Serves 4 · Prep 10 min · Cook 25 min
Ingredients:
2 chicken breasts
1 cup heavy cream
½ cup parmesan, grated
Salt and pepper to taste
Instructions:
1. Season the chicken and sear 5 minutes per side.
2. Add cream and parmesan, simmer until
thickened.
3. Serve over pasta.
#dinner #easyrecipes

text:
Lemon Bars
Makes 16 · Total 1 hr 20 min
For the crust:
1 cup flour
½ cup butter
For the filling:
2 eggs
1 cup sugar
Method
Press crust into pan and bake 15 minutes.
Whisk filling, pour over crust and bake 20 minutes.
